semantics.owner_rule: Defining contract/profile owns each machine-significant custom semantic key namespace.
semantics.key_rule: Key meaning is explicit and stable under compatible identity/version.
semantics.reuse_rule: Cross-contract reuse references shared value/type semantics rather than copying meaning inconsistently.
semantics.collision_rule: Same custom key string in different contexts does not imply same semantics unless shared contract says so.
semantics.breaking_rule: Changing custom key meaning is semantic change.

invariants.rule: Every Contract Format section and field has explicit machine-readable meaning; consumers never infer semantics from JSON ordering, filenames, indentation, prose style or neighboring fields.
These contracts document and constrain Contract Format semantics but do not replace the repository-root AIGMos_Canonical_Contract_Format_v1.4.0.json bootstrap authority.

hard_gates.condition: same key name globally assumed same meaning
consumer changes provider semantic key meaning
key copied without shared type contract
